content.title: Gabby Windey drops Love Overboard dating show on Hulu, meets contestants on luxury yacht - Art Threat
content.text: Show summary Hide summary 🔥 Quick Facts Reality TV Icon Gabby Windey Makes Her Hosting Debut The Twist That Changes Everything: The Plank and Couple-Breaking Meet the 22 Contestants Fighting for Love and Luxury How Alex Cooper and Jeff Jenkins Brought Yacht Chaos to Life Why Gabby Windey Just Became Your New Reality TV Host Sources Gabby Windey just launched Love Overboard, a steamy new dating show where 22 singles navigate luxury yacht chaos. Contestants battle for romance, break up couples, and risk getting voted off the plank. All 9 episodes dropped today on Hulu. 🔥 Quick Facts Premiere Date: March 26, 2026 on Hulu with all 9 episodes available now Host: Gabby Windey calls it “National Geographic for hot, horny people” Contestants: 22 singles competing aboard a luxury mega-yacht in Malta Executive Producers: Call Her Daddy podcaster Alex Cooper and Jeff Jenkins Reality TV Icon Gabby Windey Makes Her Hosting Debut Gabby Windey is no stranger to drama. After starring on The Bachelor and The Bachelorette, winning The Traitors season three, and competing on Dancing With the Stars, she brings serious hosting credentials. Now she oversees 22 sexy singles on a luxury yacht hunting for love in Love Overboard. “You just never know what’s going to happen when you put that many attractive people in a confined space,” Windey told People Magazine during filming in Malta last June. The show tests not just chemistry but strategy, loyalty, and nerve as contestants battle for limited premium deck space. The Twist That Changes Everything: The Plank and Couple-Breaking Love Overboard flips traditional dating competition rules on their head. Four lucky couples start living the high life on the yacht’s upper deck with all amenities. Everyone else? They work below deck as crew while hunting for romance. To escape servitude, singles must break up an existing couple and take their spot. As Windey explains in the trailer, “Some of you will find love, while others will fall from this plank behind me.” Unlucky daters literally get voted off by plunging into the water below. One contestant hilariously laments, “Why would I pick up after people I think I’m sexier than?” Messiness guaranteed. Meet the 22 Contestants Fighting for Love and Luxury The cast spans 14 singles plus 4 couples competing across diverse careers and backgrounds. From Gabby Windey hosting duties to soccer star Koray applying his charm skills, the roster includes fitness moguls, finance bros, real estate agents, and wellness professionals. Ages range from 21 to 33, creating generational tension and dynamic romantic potential. Detail Information Release Date March 26, 2026 Platform Hulu and Disney+ Total Episodes 9 (all available now) Host Gabby Windey “I think this is really a National Geographic. This is like National Geographic for hot, horny people. You really get to see how humans interact when they are trying to find love but also motivated by luxury and status.” — Gabby Windey, Host of Love Overboard How Alex Cooper and Jeff Jenkins Brought Yacht Chaos to Life Alex Cooper, podcasting powerhouse behind Call Her Daddy, executive produces through her Unwell Productions company. Jeff Jenkins partners through Jeff Jenkins Productions, known for producing The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives. Together they created a high-stakes dating environment where romance battles luxury, strategy beats sincerity, and consequences mean getting voted overboard. ABC aired a special preview of episode one on March 22, giving viewers a taste of the romance, competition, and inevitable chaos awaiting on the mega-yacht. The preview proved successful enough to launch all nine episodes simultaneously on Hulu, allowing binge-watchers to experience the complete season in one sitting. Why Gabby Windey Just Became Your New Reality TV Host Gabby Windey combines unfiltered hosting style with deep reality television experience. Unlike polished game show hosts, she brings authentic reactions to genuine drama brewing below deck. Her credibility spans winning seasons, dating chaos, and high-pressure environments from The Bachelor franchise. The Love Overboard setting demands a host who understands both romance and competition. Windey delivers commentary that acknowledges the absurdity while respecting the genuine stakes. Will love triumph? Will luxury corrupt ethics? Can six “shipwreckers” entering late destroy fragile couples already formed? Windey guides us through nine episodes of increasingly messy entanglement aboard a confined floating vessel. Sources E!
